title: pvD3
body:
## pvD3

Parallel repartitioning (distributed data decomposition): builds a k-d tree over the distributed dataset and redistributes cells so each MPI process owns a spatially contiguous, load-balanced region, optionally with ghost-cell layers; output is an unstructured grid. In a serial run it acts almost as a pass-through, but non-composite input is still converted to an unstructured grid. pvRedistributeDataSet is the newer alternative with more output control.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Image, rectilinear and structured grids become explicit unstructured grids, which can need much more memory; ParaView warns about this.
- Schemaxis serial examples do not establish MPI behaviour. Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `D3`. Identity: `filters/D3`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. ParaView: This property specifies the input to the D3 filter. Accepted data: any dataset (meshes, grids, point sets) (vtkDataSet). | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkDataSet"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `BoundaryMode` | This property determines how cells that lie on processor boundaries are handled. The "Assign cells uniquely" option assigns each boundary cell to exactly one process, which is useful for isosurfacing. Selecting "Duplicate cells" causes the cells on the boundaries to be copied to each process that shares that boundary. The "Divide cells" option breaks cells across process boundary lines so that pieces of the cell lie in different processes. This option is useful for volume rendering. | `{"type":"enum","values":["Assign cells uniquely","Duplicate cells","Divide cells"]}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"Assign cells uniquely"` |
| `MinimalMemory` | If this property is set to 1, the D3 filter requires communication routines to use minimal memory than without this restriction. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `MinimumNumberOfGhostLevels` | The minimum number of ghost levels to add to each processor's output. If the pipeline also requests ghost levels, the larger value will be used. | `{"type":"integer"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

Coverage and unbound native properties:

```json
{
  "defaults": "native defaults for omitted options",
  "gaps": {},
  "origin": "generated",
  "output": "native inspection required; explicit output-port selection available",
  "outputPorts": null,
  "qualification": "not-run"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvD3",
  "inputs": {
    "Input": "UPSTREAM_Input"
  }
}
```
